exact_claims: For a discontinuous action in characteristic zero and every G-sheaf L of vector spaces, H^1(X;G,L) is canonically identified with H^1(Y,q_*^G L).
If L is a coherent analytic equivariant module, q_*^G L is coherent analytic on Y.
The preceding assertion applies to the coherent sheaf O(E^vee tensor F).
excluded_claims: No categorical descent equivalence is asserted for nontrivial stabilizers.
No compactness or finite-dimensionality conclusion is asserted.
The preceding equivariant Ext/H^1 identification and following compact-quotient finiteness unit remain separate.

authorities.claim_bound: Separated discontinuous quotients have local finite stabilizer quotient charts and invariant structure sheaf.
Proper, hence finite, holomorphic direct image preserves coherence; Oka coherence and coherent kernel closure are also recorded.
authorities.pin: Hauptsatz I, p. 57; Oka coherence discussion p. 16

proof_obligations.claim: The separated analytic quotient has local charts U=V/H with p:V to U finite and O_U=(p_*O_V)^H.
proof_obligations.statement_status: properties stated explicitly as hypotheses/structure in the candidate

proof_obligations.claim: The underlying discontinuous action supplies a finite stabilizer H and a topological slice V whose translates are disjoint.
On the slice, invariant direct image for G identifies with invariant direct image for H; the candidate verifies this sectionwise identification is O_U-linear.
For the finite analytic quotient p:V to V/H, finite direct image carries coherent analytic modules to coherent analytic modules.
proof_obligations.bridge: A finite holomorphic map is proper.

proof_obligations.claim: For finite H, semilinearity restricts to O_U-linearity because O_U consists of invariant functions; M^H is the kernel of M to the finite direct sum indexed by H and is coherent.
Compatible bundle actions induce a G-linearization on E^vee tensor F, whose holomorphic-section sheaf is finite locally free and coherent by Oka coherence.
